result:
These queries are untested, each a single attempt from the page alone. A few rest on assumptions I couldn't check:
- `groupBy` and `indexBy` take a quoted key and turn string keys into keywords.
- `sum` of an empty vector is 0.
- `parseJson` reads numeric strings such as "2.50", which I rely on in N7.
- The page lists no `trim`, so N10 and N14 strip spaces with `split " " | join ""`. That is safe here only because the tags and requirement lines contain no meaningful inner spaces.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) | * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * {:c /customer/name :a ([(/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) (at :discount | coalesce 0 | mul -1)] | sum)} | groupBy ~/c | * {:customer (first | /c) :total (* /a | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | vals | sort ~/total | reverse | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | * count
N4: :p / | (at :dependencies | coalesce {}) | union (p | at :devDependencies | coalesce {}) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * keyword | sort
N5: /services | vals | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | {:enabledCount count :ports (* (at :port) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (* (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") | * (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0) | groupBy ~(/) | vals | * {:service first :count count} | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "") | * {:r (/0 | lower) :q (/2 | parseJson) :p (/3 | parseJson)} | * {:r /r :v (mul /q /p)} | groupBy ~/r | * (* /v | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)
N8: :ev / | (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") | * /user | distinct) | minus (ev | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") | * /user | distinct) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ":" | last | split "," | * (split " " | join "" | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "apple" "date"] | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | vals | * {:word first :count count} | filter ~(/count | gt 1) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) | * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets * (at :download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~/downloads | reverse | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | :t / | {:count count :allPriced (every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | * /name | sort)}
N14: lines | * (split "#" | first | split " " | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | indexBy ~(split "==" | first | lower) | * (split "==" | last)
